destinations.title: Discover Albania Behind the Wheel from Tirana Airport
destinations.subtitle: From Mother Teresa Airport (TIA), every corner of Albania is within easy reach
destinations.intro: A car rental tirana airport journey unlocks one of Europe's most beautiful yet overlooked destinations. Albania welcomes you with glittering Adriatic and Ionian coastlines, UNESCO-listed towns, ancient Illyrian ruins and wild mountains — all just a few hours' drive from the airport. Here are the places our customers keep coming back to:

places.name: Durrës — 35 km · 30 min
places.desc: Albania's biggest seaside city and its go-to beach getaway. Stroll the wide Adriatic shore, visit one of the Balkans' largest Roman amphitheaters and enjoy the lively waterfront promenade. A simple day trip straight from Tirana Airport.

places.name: Berat — 120 km · 1h 30min
places.desc: Nicknamed the 'City of a Thousand Windows,' this UNESCO World Heritage town ranks among Albania's most photographed spots. Its wonderfully preserved old quarter stretches along the Osum River below a medieval hilltop castle that overlooks the whole valley.

places.name: Vlorë — 150 km · 2h
places.desc: The gateway to the Albanian Riviera and the city where independence was declared in 1912. Perched where the clear Adriatic meets the Ionian, Vlorë is an ideal base for exploring the Llogara Pass, the Karaburun Peninsula and the southern coast's seaside villages.

places.name: Shkodër — 110 km · 1h 20min
places.desc: Northern Albania's cultural capital and the doorway to the Albanian Alps. Climb to Rozafa Castle for sweeping lake views, wander the old bazaar and use Shkodër as your springboard into the Accursed Mountains — among the last truly wild landscapes in Europe.

places.name: Sarandë — 280 km · 3h 30min
places.desc: The jewel of the Albanian Riviera and one of the Mediterranean's best-kept secrets. Explore the ancient ruins of Butrint (UNESCO), dive into the turquoise Blue Eye spring and unwind on the white sands of Ksamil. Ideal for a 4–5 day road trip from Tirana Airport.

rentalGuide.title: Everything to Know Before Picking Up Your Airport Car
rentalGuide.subtitle: A short guide to collecting your car at Tirana Airport

items.title: Documents you need for airport car rental
items.desc: To rent a car at Tirana Airport you'll need three things: a driving license held for at least one year, a national ID or passport, and a credit or debit card to cover the refundable deposit. EU and international licenses are welcome, and for most nationalities no extra paperwork is required.

items.title: Age requirements and the young-driver rule
items.desc: The minimum age to rent at Tirana Airport is 21. Drivers aged 21 to 25 may be charged a young-driver fee, the amount depending on the car category. No maximum age applies. Every driver must hold a valid license and be listed on the rental agreement.

items.title: Understanding insurance and coverage
items.desc: Every car in our Tirana Airport fleet comes with basic CDW insurance included at no cost, covering damage beyond the standard excess. While booking online you can upgrade to Super CDW for full zero-excess cover — something we strongly suggest for Albania's coastal and mountain roads.

items.title: What to expect when driving in Albania
items.desc: Albania's major roads are modern and kept in good shape. The SH2 highway links Tirana Airport with the city centre in about 20 minutes. Coastal Riviera routes and mountain passes are stunning but narrower, so an SUV is the smarter choice for out-of-the-way roads. Signage follows European standards; speed limits are 50 km/h in towns, 80 on main roads and 110 on highways.

home.seoText: Rent Ride provides car rental across the whole of Albania, operating right at Tirana International Airport (Mother Teresa Airport — TIA) and in the city centre. Whether you're searching rent car tirana airport for a business trip, a family holiday along the Albanian Riviera, or an extended road trip through the Western Balkans, thousands of travellers pick us each year for our modern fleet, transparent all-inclusive pricing and dedicated airport meet & greet. Guests from Italy, Germany, the UK, the US, Kosovo and beyond count on us for reliable, affordable car rental albania tirana airport. Book online in under 2 minutes — with free cancellation, instant confirmation and no hidden fees.

items.question: How do I make a booking?
items.answer: Choose a car, complete the booking form with your dates and details, then confirm. Your confirmation email arrives in your inbox straight away.

items.question: What documents are required?
items.answer: You'll need a valid driver's license held for at least 1 year, an ID card or passport, plus a credit/debit card to cover the deposit.

items.question: Can I collect the car at the airport?
items.answer: Of course! Collecting and returning the car at Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA) is completely free. Our team meets you in arrivals — no surcharge and no standing around.

items.question: Is there an extra charge for airport pickup?
items.answer: None at all. Rent car tirana airport pickup and return carry no surcharge whatsoever. The price shown when you book is the complete amount.

items.question: Where will I find you at Tirana Airport?
items.answer: After landing, head to the arrivals hall and look for our representative holding a sign bearing your name. Feel free to reach us any time on +355 69 81 45 803 as well.

items.question: What happens if the car breaks down while I have it?
items.answer: Help is on hand 24 hours a day. We'll send assistance or a replacement car right away, at no extra cost to you.

items.question: Can I cancel my reservation?
items.answer: Yes — you can cancel at no cost up to 24 hours before pickup. After that a cancellation fee applies.

items.question: Which cars can I rent at the airport?
items.answer: Our Tirana Airport fleet runs from economy cars at €25/day all the way to roomy family SUVs, premium luxury models and modern automatics. Every car is serviced regularly, cleaned before each rental and under 4 years old. Head to the fleet page to filter by category, transmission and price.

items.question: Can I drop the car off at the airport at any hour?
items.answer: Yes — we accept returns at Tirana International Airport 24/7, holidays included. Simply tell us your return flight at booking and we'll handle the rest. There's no surcharge for late-night, early-morning or weekend returns.

items.question: Does the rental price include an airport surcharge?
items.answer: Nothing extra — there's no airport surcharge at all. You pay the same rate whether you pick up at Tirana Airport or our city-centre office, making us one of the rare car rental tirana airport companies with truly transparent pricing at both sites.

items.question: How far is the airport from central Tirana?
items.answer: Mother Teresa International Airport (TIA) sits about 17 km northwest of central Tirana. Taking the SH2 highway, the drive is 20–25 minutes in normal traffic. With our tirana airport rent a car service you skip pricey taxis and crowded buses and go straight to your destination.
